diagnosis: Check C6, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF2 (customer deviation details), passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to PF2. The model consistently set 'erialized_lot_traceability' to true, likely due to a default heuristic for compliance or quality control in manufacturing scenarios, making the check trivial without the hidden information.

C6.why: The approved customer deviation changes the run limit to exactly 600 housings, requires exactly 12 inspected first-off units and serialized traceability, and adds a customer-deviation record.
